slice: CAP-038 CIDS JSON-LD node source-view attribution
contract: Every generated CIDS graph node includes a deterministic, sorted kokonut:sourceViews list identifying the signed projection view or public source-table categories used to construct it.
limitations: View-level attribution does not prove property-to-row lineage or record a content snapshot.
The worker source_scope still records the six signed input views and normalized location; production identity/grant provisioning, populated parity, and MAN-CAP-038 acceptance remain open.
